notes: Single deliverable function: fold a 2x2 tile into a 6x6 swatch via 3x3 tiling, a per-row horizontal circular shift (right by (r+1)%3) and a per-column vertical circular shift (up by (c+2)%3). Must be implemented generally; the verifier executes the module's CLI and its imported weave() on hidden tiles including uniform and sparse tiles, where wrong shift directions or offsets mismatch. Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (three ordered composable steps), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (multiple hidden tiles), and quantitative_correctness (exact integer grids). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to easy.
